integrity: Proof covers every stated integer parameter; finite checks are supplementary. Previously published theorems are explicitly credited. No independent scientific review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Single-coordinate flips only; no assertion for all hyperoctahedral involutions, nor a computation of the ambient scale-four homotopy or the inclusion-induced homology map. The scale-three sphere multiplicities are taken from Feng 2023. Full priority beyond the inspected references is unverified.
title: Coordinate-flip fixed loci in Hamming-cube Vietoris–Rips filtrations
